text: Hello, boys and girls.How are you today?Nice to see you again.Welcome back to my English class.In this period, we will go on learning Unit 8, a more enjoyable school life.In this period, you are going to read an interesting conversation between Mr.Hu and his students, learn some new words, and learn to write a report on how to make changes to the classroom.Are you ready for the class?Please get your student's book and your worksheet ready.First of all, let's play a game.I'd like you to tell me what is in the picture.Are you ready?Here we go.I will show you a part of the picture first.Can you guess what it is?One more part for you.Any ideas?You can see some desks and chairs, the blackboard, a teacher's desk.Yes, it is a classroom.Well, please take a close look at the classroom.Is it tidy?No, it isn't.There is some paper on the floor.And the desks and chairs are not put in a tidy manner.Look around the classroom.Can you find any pictures or decorations?How do you like the classroom?Does it look interesting?No, it doesn't.Nothing interesting can be seen in the classroom.It doesn't look interesting.It looks uninteresting.Do you still remember the words we learned in the last period?Necessary and unnecessary.Un means no or not, right?Now we have interesting and uninteresting.Can you guess the Chinese meaning of the word uninteresting?Yes, please read after me.What other similar examples can you think of?Tidy, untidy.Comfortable, uncomfortable.Good.Let's look at this picture.Who is in the picture?I'd like you to listen to what Mr.Who says carefully and then repeat his sentences.Our classroom looks old, untidy and uninteresting.Can you make some changes to it yourselves?I'll play it again.What does Mr.Who say?Who asks, can you make some changes to it yourselves?What does it refer to?It refers to our classroom, the old, untidy and uninteresting classroom.What does yourselves mean?It means 你们自己What does yourselves refer to?Who is Mr.Who talking to?It refers to Mr.Who's student.Yourselves is a reflexive pronoun.它是一个反身代词。And what is the reflexive pronoun for me?It should be myself.Then how to form a reflexive pronoun?We put S-E-L-F at the end of the words like him, her or it.And S-E-L-V-E-S at the end of the words like them and our, right?So what is the reflexive pronoun for him?It should be himself.What is the reflexive pronoun for her?HerselfFor them?ThemselvesFor us?OurselvesMr.Who students are looking for ways to make their classroom look more interesting.Please look at the first picture.What are they doing?They are putting up something on the display board.So guys, please look at me.What am I doing?I am putting up something on the blackboard.Then what are they putting up on the display board?Maybe some photos, some drawings or some pictures, right?Let's look at the second picture.What are Kitty and Alice doing?The desk and the floor seem to be very clean.Maybe they are doing some cleaning on today.How about this picture?Where are Joe and his classmates?They are beside the bookshelf in their classroom.What is Joe doing?Maybe Joe is doing something to put the books in order.Good guess.Now, please read and check your prediction.Please open your student's book, turn to page 52, read the first part of the conversation and answer the questions.What can the students do themselves?They can decorate the display board themselves.Here, can is a modal verb.can是一个情态动词,解释为可以。And it is followed by the verb, decorate.请太动词看,接动词原型。What can Peter and Joe do themselves?They can put up some posters on the wall themselves.How about the other students?Please read the second part of the conversation and answer the questions.So guys, what can Kitty do herself?She can sweep the floor herself.What can Alice do herself?She can clean up the desk herself.Here, clean up the desk means make the desk clean and tidy, right?How about Joe and his friends?Please read the third part of the conversation and answer the questions.He is putting the books on the shelves.在桌子上翻译书。周同学们在帮助他吗?不,他们没有。因为周同学们认为周同学能够自己去做。现在,请在录制中写下对话。在写下对话中,请与调声和声音互相关联系,并保留学生能够做的事情的详细分析。我们的学校看起来很古老,不丰富,不有趣。你们可以自己做一些改变吗?我们可以自行装置摄像头。彼得和杰尔可以把桌子上翻译书放在桌子上。我可以把桌子上翻译。阿拉斯可以把桌子上翻译。我们可以帮杰尔把书放在桌子上吗?不,他可以自己做。现在,我想让你们再次写下对话,并完成两个问题的答案。学生可以做什么改变他们的学校?谁可以改变他们的学校?请把工作室拿出来,并完成任务一。时间到了。让我们检查答案。他们可以把桌子上翻译成什么样的改变?他们可以自行装置摄像头。谁可以做?学生可以自行装置摄像头。Kitty可以自行装置摄像头。Alice可以自行装置摄像头。Joe可以自行装置摄像头。现在,我想让你们想想这些问题的答案。第一,你们可以如何改变你的学校?第二,谁可以改变学校?现在,请把工作室拿出来,并完成任务二。请想想这些问题,并写下你的工作室的答案。请尝试一下。Time is up!Have you finished?Now, I'd like you to write a report based on your notes.Please write a report about how you will make changes to your classroom based on your notes in the table.Please take out your worksheet and finish task 3.中文字幕提供 欢迎订阅我的频道If you write about what changes you can make, please give yourself a tick.If you write about who can make the changes, one more tick.Guys, how many ticks have you got?My student Jim has finished his report.Let's read his report all together.My classmates and I want to make some changes to our classroom.We can decorate the display board ourselves.I can put up some students' good homework on the display board myself.Joy can put up some of our photos on the wall herself.Lucy and Alex can clean the windows themselves.Olivia can clean up the desk herself.We hope our classroom will look tidier and more interesting with these changes.Guys, did he write about what changes he and his classmates can make?Yes, they can decorate the display board, put up some students' good homework on the display board, put up some of their photos on the wall, clean the windows, and clean up the desks.Did he write about who can make the changes?Yes, apart from Jim himself, his classmates Joy, Lucy, Alex, and Olivia can help too.How many ticks will give him?Two, of course.I think that Jim's classroom will definitely look tidier and more interesting with these changes.Guys, today we read an interesting conversation about how to make changes to the classroom.And also we learned how to write a report on how to make our classroom look more interesting.I hope that you have had a good time in today's lesson.Thank you for your hard work.How time flies, it's time to say goodbye.So much for today.Don't forget the homework.See you.
